$comment: The retired approval surface (flow-approval-consolidation task 7.2). The contract the hydra-gates anti-pattern gate reads: an app calling one of these routes or registering a listener for one of these classes is a BROKEN INTEGRATION finding, not a style finding. The shapes block lists what a leaf app must not ship at all.

antiPatternShapes.description: Ordered approval steps with the app's own advance-on-approval logic; provision a task template and open a sequence instead.
The app resolves approver groups or roles itself; the task's group performer resolves membership at decision time.
A pending/approved/rejected state machine over an app-owned approval object; the task lifecycle is the state machine.
A background sweep over approval rows for expiry; business timers with purpose 'expiry' own the clock.
A stored overdue flag, status value or column; overdue is computed from the clock against due and expiry dates.

A schema mirroring nodes, edges, limits, trigger or schedule of a flow definition; contribute node types through RegisterFlowNodesEvent and resolve definitions from the flow entity. hermiq's agentflow/agentflowrun are the measured instance; their removal is 'hermiq: retire-agentflow-object-store'.
